heartland.name: Highland Hold
heartland.title: The highlands hold the headwaters.
heartland.description: Mountain pastures and mines at the head of the river. What you do with the water reaches everyone downstream.

enclave.name: Verdant Reach
enclave.title: Knowledge takes root. Cooperation grows.
enclave.description: Old forests and fields on the west bank. Your trees store carbon and soak up floods, if you keep them.

petrostate.name: Forge Dominion
petrostate.title: Industry today. A cleaner tomorrow.
petrostate.description: Kilns and mines on the east bank. You make the bricks everyone needs, and the smoke drifts to your neighbors.

archipelago.name: Tidehaven
archipelago.title: Every river ends at your shore.
archipelago.description: The delta and the coast. Every flood and spill from upstream ends up at your harbor.
